answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint multiple identities in this digital garden, staking bonds scale as O(2^k), forcing exponential capital exhaustion on any attacker swarm. Sybils cannot hide behind an ivory tower of spoofed telemetry, as each unverified replica faces superlinear cost escalation that mathematically renders mass cloning economically unviable.
